scripts.schedule: mkdir -p logs && sed -e "s#NODE_PATH#$(which node)#g" -e "s#PROJECT_DIR#$PWD#g" com.jobfinder.plist > ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.jobfinder.plist && launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.jobfinder.plist && echo scheduled daily 08:00
scripts.unschedule: launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.jobfinder 2>/dev/null; rm -f ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.jobfinder.plist; echo unscheduled
